data.short_description: A new tea concept, The Taylor Tea House, is being built at a historic 1880s house in downtown Taylor. The shop will serve leaf tea, finger sandwiches, pastries and desserts, with a full menu to come closer to opening.

Zay's Place has filed for a liquor license at the former Twisted Duck Pub location in Springfield, suggesting a new restaurant or bar is coming. It may be a second location of the Eugene bar of the same name, though the owner could not confirm details.

data.status: currently undergoing a total overhaul, construction moving quickly
data.short_description: Baton Rouge burger spot Bun's is expanding to Lafayette with a second location after customer demand from the area. The space is being custom-built with the same menu as the original, with a grand opening projected for later this fall.

data.status: will close in late October, expected to reopen mid-November
data.short_description: Coquine will close in late October and reopen as Katy Jane's in mid-November after owner Katy Millard combines it with the neighboring cafe and market. The new concept keeps some Coquine favorites while adding more casual, approachable menu items.

Shuckin' Shack Oyster Bar, a growing seafood franchise, is building its fifth South Carolina location at 2151 Boyce Street in Columbia's BullStreet District. The restaurant will offer oysters, po-boys, fish and chips and other seafood dishes.

data.store_name: Migration Brewing (Slabtown pub and pizza kitchen)
data.short_description: Migration Brewing is opening a new pub and pizza kitchen inside the Field Office building in Portland's Slabtown neighborhood. The roughly 3,000-square-foot space will include a patio with fire features and a private event space.

Super Chix franchisee Chunara Group will open a new 2,500-square-foot location at Woodstock Mill District, which would be the brand's 51st location. The team is also planning additional locations in Athens and Lithia Springs.

data.location: 5340 W Charleston Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89146
data.short_description: Sbarro is set to open inside the Charleston & Mohawk Conoco travel center in Charleston Heights, per a recently filed city permit. A ribbon cutting and grand opening is planned a month after the actual opening.

WIN Hospitality will open a new Blue Elephant location in Ardmore, occupying part of the space currently home to Mikado Thai Pepper. The new location will accommodate 70 to 80 guests and feature signature Blue Elephant decor and menu items.

data.location: 2421 Van Fleet Cir Ste 124, Doraville, GA 30360
data.status: will be taking over the full space
data.short_description: Postern Coffee, currently operating within Minhwa Spirits in Doraville, will expand into the full space once Minhwa relocates in early November. Postern will keep its drink menu while expanding its roastery operations and pastry selection.

data.location: 15444 TX-105 (State Hwy 105 W, Suite C), Montgomery, TX 77356
data.status: construction started, slated to wrap up mid-January
data.short_description: Grit and Grind Coffee Shop is opening its second Texas cafe in Montgomery's April Sound neighborhood, per a filed permit. The roughly $300,000, 2,000-square-foot construction project is expected to be complete by early 2027.

data.location: 1198 Howell Ml Rd, Atlanta, GA 30318 (new Westside Provisions District location)
data.event_date: beginning of November (Doraville location ends service)
data.short_description: Doraville soju distillery Minhwa Spirits is relocating early next year to the Westside Provisions District, taking over the former Aziza space. The brand will end service at its Doraville tasting room at the beginning of November.

data.location: Woodruff Road, Greenville, SC (Address not specified beyond street)
data.short_description: Fast-casual salad franchise Salata Salad Kitchen is finally making its South Carolina debut on Woodruff Road in Greenville. Two more locations, in Myrtle Beach and Charleston, are already under contract though sites haven't been revealed.

data.location: Address not specified (planned near I-26 corridor, Dorchester County, Summerville, SC)
data.short_description: Buc-ee's is planning a new Summerville, SC location following its successful Florence, SC debut. The proposed 74,000-square-foot store would feature 116+ fuel pumps and the brand's full menu.

data.status: address and opening date not yet announced
data.short_description: The Heartbreak Chef, built by chef Jerome Robinson from a Caribbean-inspired catering operation, is opening a second Toronto location. The address and opening date have not yet been announced.

data.event_date: by the end of the year
data.short_description: Brasserie 1796, a French-style restaurant from two Metro Detroit locals, is under construction at the former Anchor Bay Aquarium site in downtown New Baltimore. The co-owner hopes to open by the end of the year.
Dave's Hot Chicken, the fast-growing Nashville hot chicken chain, is joining the Victory Village shopping center in Lexington County. No opening date has been announced yet for the location.

Texas de Brazil, a Brazilian churrascaria chain, is making its Gainesville debut at Butler Town Center with a spring 2027 opening. The 6,300-square-foot restaurant will offer rodízio-style, tableside meat service and a 50-item salad area.

data.status: plans to open, opening timeline unconfirmed
data.short_description: Longtime Westlake Latino gay bar The Silver Platter plans to reopen at a new address after its original home was slated for demolition. The bar secured a conditional use permit for the 1,359-square-foot new space.

data.status: plans to join, opening timeline not provided
data.short_description: Island-inspired frozen treat concept Sno Swell plans to join West Harbor, a $500 million waterfront development in San Pedro. The shop will offer Hawaiian-style shave ice, soft-serve yogurt, Dole Whip and other tropical treats.

Underscore Hospitality filed a liquor license application for a new restaurant called Miles Tavern in Fulton Market. The concept will have an outdoor patio and is attached to chef Erling Wu-Bower, also of Maxwells Trading. No further details have been released.

data.status: No opening date has been announced yet
data.short_description: Brazilian gelato chain Bacio di Latte is opening a new location at Westfield Galleria at Roseville, its first push into the Sacramento market. The brand, founded in São Paulo in 2011, has more than 250 locations worldwide with a California-concentrated U.S. footprint.

data.location: West Ashley retail center, Bees Ferry Road and Glenn McConnell Parkway, Charleston, SC
data.short_description: A new 15,000-square-foot retail center in West Ashley is under construction, featuring the second Bay Street Biergarten location among its five commercial spaces. The launch is expected next year.

data.location: West Ashley retail center (Bees Ferry Road and Glenn McConnell Parkway); San Miguel location at 1711 Shoremeade Road, Mount Pleasant, Charleston, SC
data.short_description: San Miguel Mexican Grill & Bar, a family-owned Mexican restaurant, is one of the tenants joining a new West Ashley retail development expected to open next year. Its existing Mount Pleasant location serves dishes like the San Miguel Sampler and San Miguel Bowl.

data.location: West Ashley retail center, Bees Ferry Road and Glenn McConnell Parkway, Charleston, SC
data.short_description: River Landing Dentistry is listed as one of the tenants joining the new West Ashley retail center currently under construction, alongside Bay Street Biergarten and San Miguel Mexican Grill & Bar.

data.location: West Ashley retail center, Bees Ferry Road and Glenn McConnell Parkway, Charleston, SC
data.short_description: An unnamed "golf simulator group" is listed as one of the tenants joining the new West Ashley retail center currently under construction.

data.location: 4515 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
data.short_description: Franchise owner Brian Leachman is opening a new Smoothie King in North Myrtle Beach, replacing the former 45th Ave Crab House & Bar. It will be Leachman's tenth Smoothie King and will feature a drive-thru.

Portage Bay Cafe announced it will permanently close its West Seattle location due to lack of indoor seating and rising operational costs. The location has served the neighborhood for nearly four years; four other Seattle locations will remain open.

data.location: 8480 Morrison Rd, Suite B, New Orleans, LA 70127
data.status: anticipates announcing an official opening date soon
data.short_description: Tesla's Kitchen, blending Honduran and American cuisine, is heading toward a debut in New Orleans East this fall. Owner Tesla Arzu is finishing culinary school while navigating final building inspections before opening.

Flo Cafe and Bar, a Southwestern/Tex-Mex restaurant in West Town, announced it will close because the building was sold. The restaurant has served the community for more than two decades, with its final day of service set for December 20, 2026.

data.location: 512 Rose Ave, Suite F, Venice, CA 90291
data.short_description: Wabi on Rose, a Japanese-inspired sushi and cocktail bar in Venice, has permanently closed after a six-year run. The restaurant announced the closure on social media without explaining the reason.

data.location: 1300 S Casino Center Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89104
data.short_description: Almond & Oat, a modern coffee bar concept from Kyle Cunningham, is now open at shareDOWNTOWN in the Las Vegas Arts District. It occupies nearly 1,400 sq. ft. and offers vegan-friendly drinks, specialty coffee, matcha, and pastries.
Spectators Bar & Grill opened in Conroe, Texas, expanding its presence beyond Sugar Land, Richmond and Katy. The roughly 6,500-square-foot restaurant seats 215 guests and features 40 televisions.

Two Friends Chocolates, a Boxborough-based artisan chocolate shop, is expanding with a new location in Concord, MA. Co-owners Lala Selvaraj and Neethu Viswanath announced the news on Instagram this week.

Caption by Hyatt Hillsboro, a 115-room hotel managed by PM Hotel Group, is under development near Highway 26 and Hillsboro Airport. It's part of a larger expansion that brings PM Hotel Group's Portland-area portfolio from four hotels to seven.

data.location: 22332 E 9 Mile Rd, St Clair Shores, MI 48080
data.status: lease signed; renovations not starting until 2027
data.short_description: Sprouts Farmers Market has signed a lease for its first Michigan location, a former Kroger site in St. Clair Shores. The estimated opening date is not until 2029, with renovations not starting until 2027.

data.location: 2111 Gold River Rd (Gold River Centre Lane), Gold River, CA 95670
data.short_description: Club Studio, a luxury fitness concept run by Fitness International, is coming to Gold River Town Centre as an anchor tenant. It will be the second Club Studio location in the Sacramento area, offering boutique classes, recovery services, and a juice bar.

Lululemon is coming to the base of the Tribune Tower on Magnificent Mile, which will be its closest location to downtown Chicago. The new 47,000-square-foot space will be one of the company's larger locations.

data.status: will join Buckhead Village this winter
data.short_description: Los Angeles-based fashion brand Vince will open a 2,400-square-foot boutique in Buckhead Village this winter, marking its Georgia debut and 42nd store overall. It will be located beside the Billy Reid store.

Cavender's Boot City is preparing to open its second South Carolina store, a 20,091-square-foot location in North Charleston. The store will offer Western wear, work boots, and brands like Ariat, Wrangler, and Resistol.

data.location: Ashford Dunwoody Road NE & Meadow Ln NE, Dunwoody, GA 30338
data.short_description: EōS Fitness has signed a lease for a new 63,084-square-foot gym in Dunwoody, taking over part of a former Walmart space in Perimeter Village. It will be the chain's sixth Georgia location, with additional locations planned for Austell, Alpharetta, and Roswell.
Bath & Body Works will open a new 9,000-square-foot, two-level Manhattan store in Flatiron at 129 Fifth Avenue. The retailer is targeting a fall 2027 opening.

Construction Resources is opening a new CR Design Center at The Shoppes at Seaside Farms in Mount Pleasant. A planned Spring 2026 opening did not occur, and the company has since announced a revised Fall 2026 timeline.
